{{Quote|I think separation is very, like, traumatic. When it happens to families, it's sad. But when it happens to an entire galaxy, which has millions of families, it's even sadder.|Larisselle Chatrunis on the Separatist Crisis|<ref name="Miss Coruscant" />}}
'''Larisselle Chatrunis''' was a [[Pa'lowick/Legends|Pa'lowick]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who, in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], was a participant in the [[Miss Coruscant]] competition.

==Biography==
Larisselle Chatrunis was a [[Pa'lowick/Legends|Pa'lowick]] [[Gender/Legends|female]]<ref name="Miss Coruscant" /> born around [[45 BBY/Legends|45 BBY]].<ref name="Date" /> She<ref name="CSWE" /> was a native of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lowick/Legends|Lowick]], the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of her [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="AlienSpecies" /> At the age of twenty-three in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> Chatrunis represented the [[Jrade District/Legends|Jrade District]] in the [[Miss Coruscant]]<ref name="Miss Coruscant" /> beauty<ref name="AlienSpecies" /> competition held on<ref name="Miss Coruscant" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Miss Coruscant" /> Her species had just recently learned of [[Galaxy/Legends|galactic]] society at the [[Time/Legends|time]] of her participation.<ref name="AlienSpecies" />

During the competition, she juggled whilst reciting the [[Founder's Day Allegiance]]<ref name="Miss Coruscant" /> and [[Music/Legends|sang]] during the talent portion, impressing the judges. Afterwards,<ref name="AlienSpecies" /> the Pa'lowick made a statement on the ongoing [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]], where she stated separation was traumatic. She continued by saying the separation of families is sad, but when it happens to the millions of families within a galaxy, it is even sadder.<ref name="Miss Coruscant" /> Her knowledge of and sensitivity to the crisis truly impressed the judges, as it was unusual for an individual to have such comprehension when their species was new to galactic society.<ref name="AlienSpecies" /> Chatrunis eventually won the competition, beating out the thirty-five other participants. While receiving the Miss Coruscant crown, the Pa'lowick cried with joy. Chatrunis's win was reported on the [[Great ReSynchronization|date]] 13:4:18 by the [[HoloNet News CoCo District Edition|CoCo District Edition]] of [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] in its [[HoloNet News Vol. 531|531st volume]].<ref name="Miss Coruscant" /> Her crowning garnered the Pa'lowicks increased public awareness.<ref name="AlienSpecies" />

After the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]<ref name="AlienSpecies" /> in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="19 BBY">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the formation of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref> Chatrunis's fame was curtailed due to the [[Speciesism/Legends|speciesist]] policies instated by [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. The Pa'lowick, however, joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and used her vocal talent to tour [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] with a band, gathering information to provide to the Rebels. Chatrunis's purpose was to make music so that [[Alien/Legends|alien]] individuals could be freed from oppression and encouraged ideas that she was in competition with fellow Pa'lowick musician [[Sy Snootles/Legends|Sy Snootles]] to distract from her true motives. Chatrunis survived the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the Alliance and Galactic Empire and returned to homeworld, where she lived quietly with her family and friends.<ref name="AlienSpecies" />

==Behind the scenes==
Larisselle's story may well be a reference to the original Star Wars Monopoly board game, as one of the cards depicts a Pa'lowick with the words "Win beauty contest, collect $50".
